description.value: Seasons in the Park is a long-established fine-dining restaurant perched atop Queen Elizabeth Park, offering sweeping panoramic views of the Vancouver city skyline, gardens, and North Shore mountains. Part of the Sequoia Company of Restaurants (founded 1978 in Vancouver), it serves regionally inspired cuisine built around a wood-fired grill, Pacific seafood, and locally sourced ingredients. Cyclists who climb the park road to the summit hilltop will find a full-service dining room with an outdoor patio and multiple private event spaces.
